runtime_entrypoints.name: runtime.ts
runtime_entrypoints.notes: Main SDLC pipeline entry. Graph interpreter with state machine VM, agent policy engine, execution gateway integration.

runtime_entrypoints.name: sdlc_graph
runtime_entrypoints.notes: Declarative graph kernel: types, 5 nodes, 5 edges, context-aware transitions with retry limits.

runtime_entrypoints.name: execution_gateway
runtime_entrypoints.notes: Single execution boundary routing to shadow/codex/code-review/bugfix adapters.

runtime_entrypoints.name: state_machine_vm
runtime_entrypoints.notes: Deterministic VM with transition, replay, and validation.

runtime_entrypoints.name: artifact_model
runtime_entrypoints.notes: Standardized artifact model for node outputs.

runtime_entrypoints.name: node_artifacts
runtime_entrypoints.notes: Converts node outputs to typed artifacts.

runtime_entrypoints.name: agent_policy_engine
runtime_entrypoints.notes: Multi-factor scoring engine for agent selection.

runtime_entrypoints.name: feedback_analyzer
runtime_entrypoints.notes: Pure analyzer computing agent scores and policy suggestions from trace.

runtime_entrypoints.name: policy_memory_store
runtime_entrypoints.notes: SQLite persistence for feedback records. Opt-in only.

runtime_entrypoints.name: memory_routing_shadow
runtime_entrypoints.notes: Converts memory suggestions into shadow routing decisions. Advisory only.

runtime_entrypoints.name: runtime_capabilities
runtime_entrypoints.notes: Read-only loader for runtime-capabilities.json. For tests and tooling only.

runtime_entrypoints.name: policy_memory_context
runtime_entrypoints.notes: Pure context builder for policy memory. Available but not called by runtime.

execution_adapters.name: shadow-agent-adapter
execution_adapters.notes: Universal fallback adapter. Deterministic mock execution. Returns shadow_output artifacts.

execution_adapters.name: codex-adapter
execution_adapters.notes: Real Codex CLI invocation via execFile. Feature-flagged behind SDLC_EXECUTION_MODE=codex. Only supports code_generation.

execution_adapters.name: code-review-adapter
execution_adapters.notes: Shadow code review. Scans for force_review_fail marker. Returns code_review artifacts.

execution_adapters.name: bugfix-adapter
execution_adapters.notes: Shadow bugfix. Returns bugfix_patch artifacts with attempt number. No real patches applied.

policy_modules.name: agent-policy
policy_modules.notes: Type definitions and default weights for agent policy.

policy_modules.name: agent-policy-engine
policy_modules.notes: Multi-factor scoring: complexity + node type + cost. Returns agent or null for fallback.

policy_modules.name: agent-decision
policy_modules.notes: Complexity-based agent selection. Returns null to defer to AGENT_MAP.

policy_modules.name: policy-memory-analyzer
policy_modules.notes: Reads SQLite memory and produces prefer_agent/avoid_agent advisory suggestions only.

feedback_modules.name: feedback-types
feedback_modules.notes: Type definitions for all feedback, shadow routing, and evolution proposal types.

feedback_modules.name: feedback-analyzer
feedback_modules.notes: Pure analyzer. Computes agent scores, node outcomes, review summaries, and base policy suggestions from trace + artifacts.

feedback_modules.name: review-types
feedback_modules.notes: Type definitions for code review results and findings.

memory_modules.name: policy-memory-types
memory_modules.notes: Type definitions for policy memory records, agent summaries, and memory summaries.

memory_modules.name: policy-memory-config
memory_modules.notes: Feature flags for memory read/write. Separate flags, both default disabled.

memory_modules.name: policy-memory-builder
memory_modules.notes: Pure factory building summary-only PolicyMemoryRecord from runtime output.

memory_modules.name: policy-memory-store
memory_modules.notes: SQLite persistence layer. Init, append, read summaries and agent aggregations. better-sqlite3.

memory_modules.name: policy-memory-context
memory_modules.notes: Pure context wrapper factory. Available but not called by runtime.

evolution_modules.name: evolution-proposal-analyzer
evolution_modules.notes: 5-rule proposal generator. All proposals have applied:false. Read-only output only.
